next_listen.title: Are You Ready To Outsource Your CCO?
next_listen.why_now: This practitioner discussion explains how outsourced CCO work is divided, scheduled, staffed, and kept connected to an RIA. It directly supports Module 1 discovery fluency.
listen_for: Which compliance responsibilities remain with the RIA and which work is delegated?
Which tasks recur daily, monthly, quarterly, or annually?
How do outsourced CCO firms manage capacity, evidence, calendars, and client communication?
next_listen.after_listening: Record one observation, one inference, one discovery question, and any terminology that remains unclear.
